headline: Crypto market structure: TVL, DEX volumes and stablecoins on 5 Oct 2026
summary: Ethereum leads chains by TVL at $54.37bn, followed by Solana and Base. Uniswap V4 recorded the highest 24h DEX volume at $1.12bn while Tether generated the top fees. USDT circulation stands at $184bn with USDC down 10.1% over 24h. Multiple stablecoins show peg deviations and several security incidents occurred in the prior fortnight.
